Livestock Weighted Average Report for 10/27/2026 - Final

AUCTION
                                                          This Week                 Last Reported                       Last Year
                                                                                     10/13/2026
Total Receipts:                                            892                         847                             2,163
Feeder Cattle:                                             720(80.7%)                  727(85.8%)                      1,706(78.9%)
Slaughter Cattle:                                          172(19.3%)                  120(14.2%)                        457(21.1%)

Sale made up of packages of just weaned heifers and steers. Most calves had preconditioned shots. No trend will be applicable since it's been
several weeks since last reported sale. Demand moderate to good. Received some nice moisture in the area. Supply included: 81% Feeder
Cattle (72% Steers, 28% Heifers); 19% Slaughter Cattle (100% Cows). Feeder cattle supply over 600 lbs was 17%.
